scope: New opt-in guarded measurement APIs; unchanged v074p inputs. Finite floating-point software checks, not physical validation or a continuous-path proof.

braid.node_source: Unchanged v074p VALLEY_MIRROR.json K coordinates; re-evaluate both native gaps. No node search or Newton acceptance.
braid.path_policy: Use both actual unwrapped K coordinates, their straight connecting path and explicit closed circles. K-prime arrays are exact negatives, including both nodes. No modulo wrapping or reciprocal shift.

wilson.note: Native frames, per-link polar factors, both axis links and explicit endpoint sewing. Retain all refusals; no mesh or threshold relaxation. No new bandwidth scan.

sparse.supported_mode: Explicit fixed validated basis; BM real model; dense native absolute-band comparison at every accepted sparse window. No inertia count, retry, Newton or event acceptance. Every failure is retained.

tests: Negative controls for malformed policies/indices, reality, missing external neighbor, zero frame/sign overlap, both sewing directions and the former LU counterexample. Positive isolated controls and real finite-model comparisons.
budget: One complete bounded campaign plus one clean-source test/small smoke run; retain failures and any implementation corrections. No atlas expansion.
